items.title: 6.6 Measurement of the enthalpy change of a reaction (enthalpy change napna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.6, printed page 124.

blocks.text: Physical ya chemical change mein kitni heat nikalti ya absorb hoti hai, yeh ek instrument (aala) se napi jati hai jise calorimeter kehte hain; yeh aam taur par process ke dauran temperature ki change napta hai. Sab se saada calorimeter mein ek insulated vessel (bartan, jis se heat bahar na jaye), ek stirrer (hilane wala) aur ek thermometer hota hai. Calorimeter kai types ke hain, lekin yahan sirf “Glass Calorimeter” samjhaya jayega.
Calorimetry is fact par based hai ke 1 g pani ka temperature 1 °C barhane ke liye 4.18 J energy lagti hai.

blocks.title: Specific heat capacity
blocks.text: Kisi substance ki ek fixed amount ka temperature 1 K (ya 1 °C) barhane ke liye jitni heat energy chahiye, use us ki specific heat capacity, c, kehte hain. Pani ke 1 g ke liye yeh 4.18 J hai.
Is liye pani ki specific heat capacity 4.18 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹ (ya J g⁻¹ °C⁻¹) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab definition mein 'mass 1kg' likhti hai magar value 4.18 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹ deti hai, jo 1 g ki hai. 1 kg pani ke liye yeh 4180 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ hoti hai.
Heat ki shakal mein transfer (muntaqil) hone wali energy is formula se nikalti hai:

items: q = transfer hone wali heat, joules mein
m = pani/solution ka mass, grams mein
c = pani ki specific heat = 4.184 J/g °C

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Tf aakhri (final) aur Ti shuru (initial) ka temperature hai. 1 °C ki change 1 K ki change ke barabar hai, is liye ΔT ko °C ya K kisi mein bhi likh sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: 150 g pani 20.0 °C se 24.0 °C tak garam hota hai. Is ne kitni heat absorb ki?
blocks.explanation: q = m × c × ΔT = 150 × 4.18 × 4.0 = 2508 J, yani taqreeban 2.5 kJ.

items: Calorimeter (insulated vessel, stirrer, thermometer) temperature ki change se heat napta hai.
q = c × m × ΔT; pani ki c = 4.18 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹.
